notes: CE820 is a two-piece HDBaseT 2.0 KVM extender kit: CE820L (local/transmitter, connects to PC) and CE820R (remote/receiver, connects to monitor/peripherals), linked by a single Cat5e/6/6a or ATEN 2L-2910 cable via the HDBaseT RJ-45 ports on each unit (up to 100m at 4K, 150m at 1080p in Long-Reach mode). Ports from both units are listed together, labeled "(Local)"/"(Remote)". The RJ-45 Ethernet passthrough ports are only functional on the CE820-AT variant (not CE820-ATA); no line-rate is stated by ATEN so grade is omitted for the Ethernet and HDBaseT RJ-45 ports. USB ports are rated "USB 2.0 full speed" per datasheet, so usb-2.0 grade applied to the USB-B and USB-A ports. HDMI supports up to 4096x2160/3840x2160@60Hz(4:2:0) or @30Hz(4:4:4) with HDCP 2.2, but ATEN does not state an explicit HDMI spec version (1.4/2.0), so HDMI grade is omitted per instructions rather than guessed. RS-232 is DB-9 (mapped to rs232 connector, closest match for a 9-pin D-sub serial port). Desktop/tabletop units - no rack unit size specified (not natively rack-mountable without an optional bracket kit), so rackUnits omitted. Each unit uses an external DC power adapter via a locking DC barrel jack (CE820L: 5V/2.87W; CE820R: 5V/5.37W).
